status: offline staging; no host settings or module lifecycle
sourceScope: Private archived source recipe adds six namespaced authored producers, shared ring/sum, one set of base-owned USB hooks, immutable configuration templates and an internal detached-only staging function. The checked-in builder still emits separate per-layout bases.

boardResults.scope: Frame-free emulator: all seven profiles at both speeds, exact native reference descriptors including other speed and length clamps, MIDI, storage INQUIRY, invalid/running/stale-audio refusal, interrupt-mask restoration, unchanged POST history/ramp and untouched ring sentinels.
boardResults.selector: Internal board function borrowed by the private emulator fixture; no host command or device authorization.

streamResults.scope: Automatic synthetic frames: six output geometries and off at both speeds, actual EP3 packet lengths, MIDI between closed streams, unchanged immutable base identity and old ring poison absent from packets.

producerResults.scope: Source-linked producer bodies, synthetic taps, shared ring/sum and continuous POST state across layouts/off; C-call fixture selects profiles without a host command.

postResults.scope: Exact-build maintained synthetic gain/ramp/packing/saturation/EMAC probe. Private symbol aliases select the namespaced POST producer; image bytes unchanged.

designFindings: Use immutable descriptor templates in page-contained aligned slots; select them after EP3 retirement, preserving displaced PEA register/condition state.
Keep the IRQ-masked commit bounded to selected host state and profile/length; no bulk descriptor or full-ring copy. Hardware cost still unmeasured.

One automatic synthetic stream run excluded ring poison. A later maintained build with the same reader logic exposed delayed MAIN/CUE slots under near-drain conditions; this result does not establish complete readiness. The maintained staging adapter adds a packet watermark and bounded startup clear.
limitations: No checked-in all-profile source builder option or catalogue admission.
No host settings command, reviewed session/base/profile/generation binding or one-use intentional-disconnect/recovery lease.
